Under the guidance of industry experts with extensive links to relevant sectors, government, and non-government organisations, you will gain invaluable insights into practices in Australia. This diploma allows you to explore various areas of interest within human services and social work before committing to a specific degree. This ensures that you have the opportunity to discover your passion and tailor your educational journey accordingly, providing a solid foundation for your future career path. Note: Distance education (online) students must be available to attend three compulsory five-day face-to-face intensive on campus courses. What pathways to further study does this Diploma provide? Upon successful completion of this Diploma course, you can transition to the second year of the following Bachelor program: Bachelor of Human Services
courses.careers: Upon completion, you'll have laid a strong foundation for diverse career opportunities in community planning and development, welfare services, mental health support, policy development, and rehabilitation services. With a comprehensive understanding of theory and practice, you'll be prepared to enter the workforce and make a meaningful impact on the wellbeing of individuals and communities. For those interested in pursuing Social Work, graduates of Griffith University's Bachelor of Human Services are equipped to take on various roles, including child protection, youth work, mental health services, community development, and policy planning. Similarly, for Human Services graduates, career paths include community planning, welfare services, family support, child protection, correctional services, disability support, and policy development, among others.
courses.practicalExperience: Students must meet all professional practice requirements. For more information, visit Health Placement Support Hub .

courses.name: EmpowerED University Preparation Program
courses.area: Bridging and tertiary preparation.
courses.prerequisites: Applicants who successfully complete the EmpowerED University Preparation Program with a GPA of 4 or above, will be eligible for guaranteed admission* into a range of Griffith degrees. *Guaranteed admission applies to rank only. Applicants must still meet all other requirements for admission such as additional prerequisites. For further details visit EmpowerED University Preparation Program .
courses.fees: Refer to Griffith University current fee information .
courses.summary: The EmpowerED University Preparation Program provides a pathway for applicants who don't meet the formal admission requirements to enter an undergraduate degree at Griffith University. This free, comprehensive preparatory program, gives you the opportunity to experience university life while building your confidence and academic study skills. You'll gain fundamental knowledge and skills - including the essentials of critical reading, writing and referencing - in a supportive learning environment. Note: Students currently enrolled in Year 12 are not eligible for admission. This program is offered full-time and part-time at the Gold Coast and Logan campuses. Courses are also available online. Each course is delivered in a 6-week block model with two, three-hour workshops per week. Students will complete the program full-time from January to June or July to December.
courses.careers: You'll be set up for success through courses covering university preparation, academic study skills, communication and academic research, and mathematics essentials. You'll even be able to start shaping your future career now with a personalised employability plan.
